Messages.Author: Talo...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
"If a member of the owning clan controlled by the gargoyles controller
is blocked, the controller can tap the slave gargoyle to cancel the
combat and untap the acting vampire and have the slave gargoyle enter
combat with the blocking minion instead."

Can I do this with a gargoyle slave ally when my !tremere is blocked?

T

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No, since the ally is not a "Tremere anitribu slave".
He's not a "slave" in any sense of the game term.
The ally is also not a Gargoyle for any game purpose.

See http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/BLgar.html
